profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer | AI Training Expert | LLM Evaluation amp; Model Training | Generative AI | React, TypeScript, Python amp; AWS
profile.summary:
I’m a versatile professional with experience across sales, operations, management, logistics, customer service, and technology. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Computer Information Systems and have built a strong reputation for communication, organization, problem-solving, and attention to detail.
Some of my current work includes AI and LLM evaluation, structured data review, fact verification, prompt and response evaluation, identifying inconsistencies and hallucinations, response ranking, and quality assurance.
Throughout my career, I’ve managed daily operations, trained employees, maintained accurate documentation, supported customers and residents, and completed high-volume assignments according to detailed guidelines.
I’m open to opportunities where I can apply my experience in operations, technology, AI evaluation, data quality, logistics, sales, or customer support.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed scalable document automation platforms using Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and NestJS, supporting 10,000+ users.

• Designed AI-powered contract review solutions leveraging Generative AI and chatbot technologies, improving review efficiency by over 40%.

• Built modern React Native applications, increasing platform adoption by 35% and reducing document review time from 25 to approximately 15 minutes.• Optimized cloud infrastructure using Docker, Redis, and Kafka, achieving 99.8% system uptime.

• Implemented secure OAuth authentication and role-based access control supporting 5,000+ concurrent users.

• Engineered healthcare analytics solutions using Svelte and Python, reducing manual reporting time by approximately 30%.

• Mentored teams of 4–6 engineers, improving CI/CD workflows, automated testing, and deployment reliability.

positions.title: Founding engineer
positions.description:
Modernized core financial transaction systems processing ~1.5M+ transactions per day for global clients, rebuilding key services with Python, Django,
MySQL, and GraphQL while maintaining 99.9% uptime, strict data integrity, and compliance with financial industry standards.

Built and improved customer onboarding and digital payment flows used by 200K+ monthly active users, developing web interfaces with Vue/Nuxt and
TypeScript/Pinia in collaboration with product and data teams.

Enhanced financial analytics and reporting platforms serving 100+ partner institutions, optimizing GraphQL queries and backend aggregation to reduce
average report generation time from 12 seconds to under 8 seconds.

Implemented AI/ML-based anomaly detection models that analyzed millions of transaction records daily, reducing reporting latency by ~35% and
manual reconciliation efforts by 25%.

Deployed and operated production workloads on AWS and GCP for 30+ microservices, leveraging Docker, Kubernetes, and serverless functions, which
improved system availability to 99.9% and reduced deployment inconsistencies by ~40%.

Worked closely with compliance and security teams to ensure 100% of customer data and transaction flows met evolving financial regulations, contributing to zero critical audit findings across multiple reviews.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained enterprise-scale full-stack applications using React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, supporting 6,000+ users across four regions.

• Redesigned business intelligence dashboards using React, jQuery, and REST APIs, reducing average load times from 8–10 seconds to approximately 3–4 seconds.

• Designed and integrated 20+ RESTful APIs connecting CRM, reporting, and analytics platforms, reducing operational overhead by approximately 25%.

• Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Netlify, enabling on-demand deployments and reducing production rollback incidents by approximately 40%.

• Developed 200+ automated unit and end-to-end tests, reducing post-deployment defects by over 30% across three major releases.

• Collaborated with cross-functional Agile/Scrum teams, consistently delivering 95%+ of sprint commitments on schedule.

• Mentored developers through code reviews, technical discussions, and React performance optimization, improving code quality and team productivity.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed configurable workflow management applications using React and TypeScript, enabling laboratory administrators to build complex testing pipelines with drag-and-drop interfaces, conditional logic, and automated validation.

• Architected scalable, event-driven microservices using Node.js and AWS Lambda, supporting the processing of thousands of laboratory samples daily.

• Implemented real-time workflow monitoring using WebSockets, allowing laboratory technicians and managers to track sample processing, identify bottlenecks, and resolve execution failures.

• Optimized PostgreSQL database schemas and queries, reducing workflow retrieval and rendering times by approximately 40%.

• Developed automated validation systems with configurable rules and thresholds, reducing manual review efforts and improving laboratory operational efficiency.

• Strengthened application reliability through advanced error handling, retry mechanisms, and idempotent execution logic, reducing workflow execution failures by 30%.

• Collaborated with QA and DevOps teams to improve CI/CD pipelines, staging validation, production monitoring, and reliable software deployments in regulated environments.
